_comment: Steam Workshop published file IDs, one per terrain. 0 means the item has never been published - tools/steam/publish_workshop.sh treats 0 as 'create a new item', and records the assigned ID here automatically (or tells you how to record it by hand if it couldn't parse steamcmd's output). Commit this file after a terrain's first successful publish, or the next run creates a duplicate item instead of updating the existing one.
